# 2. Parent Paper Preprocessing
##2.1 Core Preprocessing Functions
```{r}
normalizeToBitcoin <- function(user_bets) {
  user_bets %>% 
    mutate(
      bet_value = bet_value * 1e-8,
      answer_value = answer_value * 1e-8
    )
}

aggregateUser <- function(user_bets) {
  user_bets %>% 
    mutate(
      last_outcome = answer_value - bet_value,
      win_answer_value = ifelse(
        status == "win",
        answer_value - bet_value,
        0
      ),
      loose_answer_value = ifelse(
        status == "loss",
        answer_value - bet_value,
        0
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      dice_balance = cumsum(answer_value - bet_value),
      winsum = cumsum(win_answer_value),
      loosesum = cumsum(loose_answer_value)
    )
}

addlag <- function(user_bets) {
  user_bets %>% 
    mutate(
      bet_pred = lead(bet_value, n = 1),
      game_pred = lead(odds, n = 1),
      time_nextbet = lead(time_bet, n = 1),
      status_pred = lead(status, n = 1)
    )
}
```

##2.3 User-Level Transaction Preparation
```{r user-preparation}
extractAndPrepareUser <- function(x, ...) {
  
  ret <- x %>%
    arrange(time_bet) %>% 
    normalizeToBitcoin() %>% 
    addlag() %>% 
    aggregateUser() %>% 
    left_join(pwin_to_prob, by = "odds") %>%
    left_join(
      pwin_to_prob %>% rename(pwin_pred = pwin),
      by = c("game_pred" = "odds")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      bet_changed = bet_pred != bet_value,
      game_changed = game_pred != odds,
      exp_changed = bet_pred * game_pred != bet_value * odds,
      
      bet_changed_factor =
        sign(bet_value - bet_pred) %>% factor(levels = c(0, 1, -1)),
      
      game_changed_factor =
        sign(game_pred - odds) %>% factor(levels = c(0, 1, -1)),
      
      exp_changed_factor =
        sign(bet_pred * game_pred - bet_value * odds) %>%
        factor(levels = c(0, 1, -1)),
      
      expectation = bet_pred * game_pred,
      exp_change_ratio =
        log(bet_pred * game_pred / (bet_value * odds)),
      bet_change_ratio =
        log(bet_pred / bet_value),
      game_diff_ratio =
        log(pwin_pred / pwin),
      
      win_cumm_log =
        log10(1 + abs(winsum)),
      loose_cumm_log =
        log10(1 + abs(loosesum)),
      dice_balance_log =
        log10(1 + abs(dice_balance)),
      dice_balance_sign =
        as.character(sign(dice_balance)),
      
      streak = 0,
      difftime = time_nextbet - time_bet,
      stayed =
        !((time_nextbet - time_bet) > 4 * 3600) &
        (timediff < 3600),
      stay_length = 1,
      game_streak = 0,
      streak_total_length = 0,
      streak_balance = 0
    ) %>%
    drop_na()

  for (i in 1:nrow(ret)) {
    
    if (i == 1) {
      
      ret$streak[i] = 0
      ret$stay_length[i] = 1
      ret$game_streak[i] = 0
      ret$streak_balance[i] = 0
      
    } else {
      
      # Win/loss streak
      if (ret$status[i] == ret$status[i - 1]) {
        ret$streak[i] =
          ret$streak[i - 1] + 1
        
        ret$streak_balance[i] =
          ret$streak_balance[i - 1] +
          ret$answer_value[i] -
          ret$bet_value[i]
        
      } else {
        ret$streak[i] = 0
        ret$streak_balance[i] = 0
      }
      
      # Session/stay length
      if (ret$stayed[i]) {
        ret$stay_length[i] =
          ret$stay_length[i - 1] + 1
      } else {
        ret$stay_length[i] = 1
      }
      
      # Same-game streak
      if (!ret$game_changed[i]) {
        ret$game_streak[i] =
          ret$game_streak[i - 1] + 1
      } else {
        ret$game_streak[i] = 0
      }
    }
  }

  for (i in nrow(ret):1) {
    
    if (i == nrow(ret)) {
      
      ret$streak_total_length[i] =
        ret$streak[i]
      
      streak_total_length =
        ret$streak[i]
      
    } else {
      
      if (streak_total_length & ret$streak[i]) {
        
        ret$streak_total_length[i] =
          streak_total_length
        
      } else if (streak_total_length & !ret$streak[i]) {
        
        ret$streak_total_length[i] =
          streak_total_length
        
        streak_total_length = 0
        
      } else if (!streak_total_length & ret$streak[i]) {
        
        streak_total_length =
          ret$streak[i]
        
        ret$streak_total_length[i] =
          streak_total_length
        
      } else {
        
        ret$streak_total_length[i] =
          streak_total_length
      }
    }
  }

  return(
    ret %>%
      arrange(time_bet)
  )
}

prepare_user_table <- function(user_bets_matched, min_games = 2, ...) {
  
  user_bets_matched %>% 
    drop_na() %>%
    group_by(userID) %>% 
    mutate(ngamez = n()) %>% 
    filter(ngamez > min_games) %>%
    group_modify(extractAndPrepareUser) %>%
    ungroup()
}
```

# 3. Construct Player Active-Day Timelines

## 3.1 Test Active-Day Mapping on Samples
```{r}
create_active_day_map <- function(prepared_sample) {
  prepared_sample %>%
    mutate(
      date = as.POSIXct(time_bet, origin = "1970-01-01") %>%
        as.Date()
    ) %>%
    distinct(userID, date) %>%
    arrange(userID, date) %>%
    group_by(userID) %>%
    mutate(active_day = row_number()) %>%
    ungroup()
}

active_day_map_sample1 <- create_active_day_map(prepared_sample1)
active_day_map_sample2 <- create_active_day_map(prepared_sample2)
active_day_map_sample3 <- create_active_day_map(prepared_sample3)
active_day_map_sample4 <- create_active_day_map(prepared_sample4)

head(active_day_map_sample5, 20)
```

## 3.2 Parent-Paper Player Eligibility
```{r}
create_parent_datemap <- function(prepared_sample) {
  prepared_sample %>%
    mutate(
      date = as.POSIXct(time_bet, origin = "1970-01-01") %>%
        as.Date()
    ) %>%
    count(userID, date, name = "nplays") %>%
    group_by(userID) %>%
    arrange(date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      nthday = row_number(),
      first_betday = min(date)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(
      first_betday < max(date) - 10
    )
}

parent_datemap_sample1 <- create_parent_datemap(prepared_sample1)
parent_datemap_sample2 <- create_parent_datemap(prepared_sample2)
parent_datemap_sample3 <- create_parent_datemap(prepared_sample3)
parent_datemap_sample4 <- create_parent_datemap(prepared_sample4)
parent_datemap_sample5 <- create_parent_datemap(prepared_sample5)
```

```{r}
get_parent_eligible_players <- function(active_day_map) {

  sample_end <- max(active_day_map$date)

  active_day_map %>%
    group_by(userID) %>%
    summarise(
      first_betday = min(date),
      total_active_days = max(active_day),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(
      first_betday < sample_end - 10
    )
}

eligible_sample1 <- get_parent_eligible_players(active_day_map_sample1)
eligible_sample2 <- get_parent_eligible_players(active_day_map_sample2)
eligible_sample3 <- get_parent_eligible_players(active_day_map_sample3)
eligible_sample4 <- get_parent_eligible_players(active_day_map_sample4)
eligible_sample5 <- get_parent_eligible_players(active_day_map_sample5)

    nrow(eligible_sample1),
    nrow(eligible_sample2),
    nrow(eligible_sample3),
    nrow(eligible_sample4),
    nrow(eligible_sample5)
  )
)
```



```{r}
count_cluster_eligible <- function(eligible_players, active_day_map) {
  active_day_map %>%
    semi_join(eligible_players, by = "userID") %>%
    group_by(userID) %>%
    summarise(
      total_active_days = max(active_day),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(total_active_days >= 4) %>%
    summarise(
      cluster_eligible_players = n()
    )
}

tibble(
  sample = 1:5,
  cluster_eligible_players = c(
    count_cluster_eligible(eligible_sample1, active_day_map_sample1)$cluster_eligible_players,

    count_cluster_eligible(eligible_sample3, active_day_map_sample3)$cluster_eligible_players,
    count_cluster_eligible(eligible_sample4, active_day_map_sample4)$cluster_eligible_players,
    count_cluster_eligible(eligible_sample5, active_day_map_sample5)$cluster_eligible_players
  )
)
```

## 4.2 Application to Samples
```{r}
create_analysis_sets <- function(prepared_sample, active_day_map, eligible_players) {

  analysis_players <- active_day_map %>%
    semi_join(eligible_players, by = "userID") %>%
    group_by(userID) %>%
    filter(max(active_day) >= 4) %>%
    ungroup()

  transactions_with_day <- prepared_sample %>%
    mutate(
      date = as.POSIXct(time_bet, origin = "1970-01-01") %>%
        as.Date()
    ) %>%
    inner_join(
      analysis_players %>%
        select(userID, date, active_day),
      by = c("userID", "date")
    )

  observation_set <- transactions_with_day %>%
    filter(active_day %in% 1:3)

  target_set <- transactions_with_day %>%
    filter(active_day %in% 4:10)

  list(
    observation = observation_set,
    target = target_set
  )
}


sets_sample1 <- create_analysis_sets(
  prepared_sample1,
  active_day_map_sample1,
  eligible_sample1
)

sets_sample2 <- create_analysis_sets(
  prepared_sample2,
  active_day_map_sample2,
  eligible_sample2
)

sets_sample3 <- create_analysis_sets(
  prepared_sample3,
  active_day_map_sample3,
  eligible_sample3
)

sets_sample4 <- create_analysis_sets(
  prepared_sample4,
  active_day_map_sample4,
  eligible_sample4
)

sets_sample5 <- create_analysis_sets(
  prepared_sample5,
  active_day_map_sample5,
  eligible_sample5
)


tibble(
  sample = 1:5,
  observation_players = c(
    n_distinct(sets_sample1$observation$userID),
    n_distinct(sets_sample2$observation$userID),
    n_distinct(sets_sample3$observation$userID),
    n_distinct(sets_sample4$observation$userID),
    n_distinct(sets_sample5$observation$userID)

  target_players = c(
    n_distinct(sets_sample1$target$userID),
    n_distinct(sets_sample2$target$userID),
    n_distinct(sets_sample3$target$userID),
    n_distinct(sets_sample4$target$userID),
    n_distinct(sets_sample5$target$userID)
  )
)
```

# 5. Construct Casual/Intensive Clustering Target

## 5.1 Build Target-Period Clustering Features
```{r}
create_target_stats <- function(target_set) {
  target_set %>%
    mutate(
      log10_bet_value = log10(bet_value),
      payout_value = answer_value - bet_value
    ) %>%
    group_by(userID) %>%
    summarise(
      ngames = log10(n()),
      ndays = n_distinct(date),
      session_per_day = (sum(difftime > 3600) + 1) / n_distinct(date),
      pwin_median = median(pwin),
      pwin_width = max(pwin) - min(pwin),
      bet_mean_log10 = mean(log10_bet_value),
      bet_max_log10 = max(log10_bet_value),
      payout_total = sum(payout_value),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

target_stats_sample1 <- create_target_stats(sets_sample1$target)
target_stats_sample2 <- create_target_stats(sets_sample2$target)
target_stats_sample3 <- create_target_stats(sets_sample3$target)
target_stats_sample4 <- create_target_stats(sets_sample4$target)
target_stats_sample5 <- create_target_stats(sets_sample5$target)

tibble(
  sample = 1:5,
  target_rows = c(
    nrow(target_stats_sample1),
    nrow(target_stats_sample2),
    nrow(target_stats_sample3),
    nrow(target_stats_sample4),
    nrow(target_stats_sample5)
  )
)
```

## 5.2 Create Training Clustering Dataset
```{r}
target_stats_train <- bind_rows(
  target_stats_sample1 %>% mutate(sample = 1),
  target_stats_sample2 %>% mutate(sample = 2),
  target_stats_sample3 %>% mutate(sample = 3)
)
```
## 5.3 Fit Training Clustering Model
```{r}
clustering_vars <- c(
  "ngames",
  "ndays",
  "session_per_day",
  "pwin_median",
  "pwin_width",
  "bet_mean_log10",
  "bet_max_log10",
  "payout_total"
)

scaled_target_train <- scale(
  target_stats_train %>%
    select(all_of(clustering_vars))
)

set.seed(123)

km_train <- trimcluster::trimkmeans(
  scaled_target_train,
  k = 2,
  trim = 0.01,
  runs = 100
)

table(km_train$classification)
```

## 5.4 Inspect Cluster Characteristics
```{r}
clustered_train <- target_stats_train %>%
  mutate(cluster = km_train$classification)

clustered_train %>%
  filter(cluster != 3) %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n_players = n(),
    median_ngames = median(ngames),
    median_ndays = median(ndays),
    median_session_per_day = median(session_per_day),
    median_pwin = median(pwin_median),
    median_pwin_width = median(pwin_width),
    median_bet_mean = median(bet_mean_log10),
    median_bet_max = median(bet_max_log10),
    median_payout = median(payout_total)
  )
```
```{r}
clustered_train <- clustered_train %>%
  mutate(
    target = case_when(
      cluster == 1 ~ "Casual",
      cluster == 2 ~ "Intensive",
      cluster == 3 ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
table(clustered_train$target, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r}
km_train$means
```

## 5.5 Assign Test Players to Training Clusters
```{r}
train_center <- attr(scaled_target_train, "scaled:center")
train_scale <- attr(scaled_target_train, "scaled:scale")

scaled_target_sample4 <- scale(
  target_stats_sample4 %>%
    select(all_of(clustering_vars)),
  center = train_center,
  scale = train_scale
)

assign_nearest_cluster <- function(data, centers) {
  apply(data, 1, function(player) {
    distances <- apply(
      centers,
      1,
      function(center) sum((player - center)^2)
    )

    which.min(distances)
  })
}

target_stats_sample4 <- target_stats_sample4 %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = assign_nearest_cluster(
      scaled_target_sample4,
      km_train$means
    ),
    target = ifelse(
      cluster == 1,
      "Casual",
      "Intensive"
    )
  )

table(target_stats_sample4$target)
```
## 5.6 Assign Validation Players to Training Clusters
```{r}
scaled_target_sample5 <- scale(
  target_stats_sample5 %>%
    select(all_of(clustering_vars)),
  center = train_center,
  scale = train_scale
)

target_stats_sample5 <- target_stats_sample5 %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = assign_nearest_cluster(
      scaled_target_sample5,
      km_train$means
    ),
    target = ifelse(
      cluster == 1,
      "Casual",
      "Intensive"
    )
  )

table(target_stats_sample5$target)
```

# 6. Construct Predictor Features

## 6.1 Static Features
```{r}
create_static_features <- function(observation_set) {
  observation_set %>%
    mutate(
      log10_bet_value = log10(bet_value),
      payout_value = answer_value - bet_value
    ) %>%
    group_by(userID) %>%
    summarise(
      static_ngames = log10(n()),
      static_session_per_day = (sum(difftime > 3600) + 1) / n_distinct(date),
      static_pwin_median = median(pwin),
      static_pwin_width = max(pwin) - min(pwin),
      static_bet_mean_log10 = mean(log10_bet_value),
      static_bet_max_log10 = max(log10_bet_value),
      static_payout_total = sum(payout_value),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

static_sample1 <- create_static_features(sets_sample1$observation)
static_sample2 <- create_static_features(sets_sample2$observation)
static_sample3 <- create_static_features(sets_sample3$observation)
static_sample4 <- create_static_features(sets_sample4$observation)
static_sample5 <- create_static_features(sets_sample5$observation)

tibble(
  sample = 1:5,
  static_rows = c(
    nrow(static_sample1),
    nrow(static_sample2),
    nrow(static_sample3),
    nrow(static_sample4),
    nrow(static_sample5)
  )
)
```
## 6.2 Temporal Features
```{r}
create_temporal_features <- function(observation_set) {

  daily_temporal <- observation_set %>%
    mutate(
      log10_bet_value = log10(bet_value)
    ) %>%
    group_by(userID, active_day) %>%
    summarise(
      daily_ngames = log10(n()),
      daily_sessions = sum(difftime > 3600) + 1,
      daily_pwin_median = median(pwin),
      daily_bet_mean_log10 = mean(log10_bet_value),
      daily_bet_max_log10 = max(log10_bet_value),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  daily_temporal %>%
    group_by(userID) %>%
    summarise(
      temporal_ngames_change =
        daily_ngames[active_day == 3] - daily_ngames[active_day == 1],

      temporal_sessions_change =
        daily_sessions[active_day == 3] - daily_sessions[active_day == 1],

      temporal_pwin_change =
        daily_pwin_median[active_day == 3] - daily_pwin_median[active_day == 1],

      temporal_bet_mean_change =
        daily_bet_mean_log10[active_day == 3] -
        daily_bet_mean_log10[active_day == 1],

      temporal_bet_max_change =
        daily_bet_max_log10[active_day == 3] -
        daily_bet_max_log10[active_day == 1],

      temporal_ngames_variability =
        sd(daily_ngames),

      temporal_pwin_variability =
        sd(daily_pwin_median),

      temporal_bet_mean_variability =
        sd(daily_bet_mean_log10),

      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

temporal_sample1 <- create_temporal_features(sets_sample1$observation)
temporal_sample2 <- create_temporal_features(sets_sample2$observation)
temporal_sample3 <- create_temporal_features(sets_sample3$observation)
temporal_sample4 <- create_temporal_features(sets_sample4$observation)
temporal_sample5 <- create_temporal_features(sets_sample5$observation)

tibble(
  sample = 1:5,
  temporal_rows = c(
    nrow(temporal_sample1),
    nrow(temporal_sample2),
    nrow(temporal_sample3),
    nrow(temporal_sample4),
    nrow(temporal_sample5)
  ),
  missing_values = c(
    sum(is.na(temporal_sample1)),
    sum(is.na(temporal_sample2)),
    sum(is.na(temporal_sample3)),
    sum(is.na(temporal_sample4)),
    sum(is.na(temporal_sample5))
  )
)
```
# 7. Construct Modeling Datasets

## 7.1 Combine Features and Targets
```{r}
# Training labels from the clustering fitted on Samples 1-3

  filter(!is.na(target)) %>%
  select(sample, userID, target)

# Build training feature table

  static_sample1 %>%
    left_join(temporal_sample1, by = "userID") %>%
    mutate(sample = 1),

  static_sample2 %>%
    left_join(temporal_sample2, by = "userID") %>%
    mutate(sample = 2),

  static_sample3 %>%
    left_join(temporal_sample3, by = "userID") %>%
    mutate(sample = 3)
)

train_master <- train_features %>%
  inner_join(
    train_labels,
    by = c("sample", "userID")

# Test table: Sample 4

# Validation table: Sample 5
```

## 8.4 Logistic Regression Model-Fit Comparison
```{r}
# AIC comparison
AIC(
  logit_static,
  logit_temporal,
  logit_combined
)

# Likelihood-ratio test:
# Does adding Temporal features significantly improve
# the Static model?
anova(
  logit_static,
  logit_combined,
  test = "LRT"
)

# Nagelkerke R-squared
nagelkerke_r2 <- function(model) {

  n <- nobs(model)

  ll_model <- as.numeric(logLik(model))

  null_model <- update(
    model,
    . ~ 1
  )

  ll_null <- as.numeric(logLik(null_model))

  cox_snell <- 1 - exp(
    (2 / n) * (ll_null - ll_model)
  )

  nagelkerke <- cox_snell /
    (1 - exp((2 / n) * ll_null))

  nagelkerke
}

r2_results <- tibble(
  feature_set = c(
    "Static",
    "Temporal",
    "Combined"
  ),
  Nagelkerke_R2 = c(
    nagelkerke_r2(logit_static),
    nagelkerke_r2(logit_temporal),
    nagelkerke_r2(logit_combined)
  )
)

r2_results
```

## 8.6 Logistic Regression Results Summary

```{r}
# Extract AIC values
aic_results <- tibble(
  feature_set = c("Static", "Temporal", "Combined"),
  AIC = c(
    AIC(logit_static),
    AIC(logit_temporal),
    AIC(logit_combined)
  )
)

# Extract likelihood-ratio test p-value
lrt_result <- anova(
  logit_static,
  logit_combined,
  test = "LRT"
)

lrt_p_value <- lrt_result$`Pr(>Chi)`[2]

# Combine all Logistic Regression results
logit_summary <- aic_results %>%
  left_join(r2_results, by = "feature_set") %>%
  left_join(
    logit_test_results %>%
      rename(
        Test_ROC_AUC = ROC_AUC,
        Test_AUPRC = AUPRC
      ),
    by = "feature_set"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    logit_validation_results %>%
      rename(
        Validation_ROC_AUC = ROC_AUC,
        Validation_AUPRC = AUPRC
      ),
    by = "feature_set"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    LRT_vs_Static_p = case_when(
      feature_set == "Combined" ~ lrt_p_value,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
logit_summary <- logit_summary %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      ~ round(.x, 3)
    )
  )

logit_summary
```

```{r}
  newdata = temporal_validation %>% select(-target)
)

xgb_combined_validation_prob <- predict(
  xgb_combined,
  newdata = combined_validation %>% select(-target)
)


# ROC AUC
xgb_static_validation_roc <- pROC::roc(
  validation_actual,
  xgb_static_validation_prob,
  levels = c("Casual", "Intensive"),
  direction = "<",
  quiet = TRUE
)

xgb_temporal_validation_roc <- pROC::roc(
  validation_actual,
  xgb_temporal_validation_prob,
  levels = c("Casual", "Intensive"),
  direction = "<",
  quiet = TRUE
)

xgb_combined_validation_roc <- pROC::roc(
  validation_actual,
  xgb_combined_validation_prob,
  levels = c("Casual", "Intensive"),
  direction = "<",
  quiet = TRUE
)


# AUPRC
xgb_static_validation_pr <- PRROC::pr.curve(
  scores.class0 =
    xgb_static_validation_prob[validation_actual == "Intensive"],
  scores.class1 =
    xgb_static_validation_prob[validation_actual == "Casual"],
  curve = FALSE
)

xgb_temporal_validation_pr <- PRROC::pr.curve(
  scores.class0 =
    xgb_temporal_validation_prob[validation_actual == "Intensive"],
  scores.class1 =
    xgb_temporal_validation_prob[validation_actual == "Casual"],
  curve = FALSE
)

xgb_combined_validation_pr <- PRROC::pr.curve(
  scores.class0 =
    xgb_combined_validation_prob[validation_actual == "Intensive"],
  scores.class1 =
    xgb_combined_validation_prob[validation_actual == "Casual"],
  curve = FALSE
)


xgb_validation_results <- tibble(
  feature_set = c("Static", "Temporal", "Combined"),
  ROC_AUC = c(
    as.numeric(pROC::auc(xgb_static_validation_roc)),
    as.numeric(pROC::auc(xgb_temporal_validation_roc)),
    as.numeric(pROC::auc(xgb_combined_validation_roc))
  ),
  AUPRC = c(
    xgb_static_validation_pr$auc.integral,
    xgb_temporal_validation_pr$auc.integral,
    xgb_combined_validation_pr$auc.integral
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      ~ round(.x, 3)
    )
  )

xgb_validation_results
```
## 10.4 XGBoost Results Summary

```{r}
xgb_summary <- xgb_test_results %>%
  rename(
    Test_ROC_AUC = ROC_AUC,
    Test_AUPRC = AUPRC
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    xgb_validation_results %>%
      rename(
        Validation_ROC_AUC = ROC_AUC,
        Validation_AUPRC = AUPRC
      ),
    by = "feature_set"
  )

xgb_summary
```
# 11. SHAP Analysis

## 11.1 Compute SHAP Values and Global Feature Importance

```{r}
# Validation predictors used by the Combined XGBoost model
shap_X <- combined_validation %>%
  select(-target)

# Convert to numeric matrix
shap_X_matrix <- data.matrix(shap_X)

# Calculate SHAP contributions directly from XGBoost
shap_raw <- predict(
  xgb_combined,
  newdata = shap_X_matrix,
  type = "contrib"
)

# Verify expected shape:
# 260 validation players x 16 columns
# (15 predictors + 1 intercept/bias column)
dim(shap_raw)
colnames(shap_raw)

# Separate predictor SHAP values from the final bias column
shap_values <- shap_raw[, 1:(ncol(shap_raw) - 1), drop = FALSE]

# Ensure predictor names match
colnames(shap_values) <- colnames(shap_X_matrix)

# Baseline/intercept contribution
shap_baseline <- mean(shap_raw[, ncol(shap_raw)])

# Create shapviz object
shap_combined <- shapviz::shapviz(
  shap_values,
  X = shap_X,
  baseline = shap_baseline
)

# Global SHAP importance
shap_importance <- tibble(
  feature = colnames(shap_values),
  mean_abs_shap = colMeans(abs(shap_values))
) %>%
  mutate(
    feature_type = if_else(
      str_starts(feature, "static_"),
      "Static",
      "Temporal"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_abs_shap)) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_abs_shap = round(mean_abs_shap, 3)
  )

shap_importance
```


## 11.2 SHAP Importance by Feature Type

```{r}
shap_type_importance <- shap_importance %>%
  group_by(feature_type) %>%
  summarise(
    total_mean_abs_shap = sum(mean_abs_shap),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = total_mean_abs_shap / sum(total_mean_abs_shap)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      ~ round(.x, 3)
    )
  )

shap_type_importance
```

## 11.3 SHAP Beeswarm Plot

```{r}
shapviz::sv_importance(
  shap_combined,
  kind = "bee",
  max_display = 15
)
```
